description: Confirm one draft match request and add it to the matching pool. The other requests of the user do not change. It stays active until the user withdraws it. Call this ONLY after the user approves the exact stored text. Always pass its request_id.

request_id.description: The request_id from create_match_request or check_matches. Always name the exact request that the user approved, or asked you to withdraw.

name: confirm_match_request

pipeline_completed.description: False when matching ran out of time. It finishes in the background.

title: Confirm the draft match request
